summary: The Ruby SDK needs to implement retry logic for schedule updates when the server returns 'mismatched conflict token' errors. Currently, no SDK has conflict token retry support for schedule updates.
userImpact: Users cannot reliably update schedules when conflict token mismatches occur, requiring manual retry logic or workarounds.
rootCause: The Temporal server now returns 'mismatched conflict token' errors during schedule updates (as of temporal/temporal#8474), but the Ruby SDK lacks automatic retry logic to handle this.
keyQuote: No SDK passes or retries on the conflict token for schedule updates. The server returns 'mismatched conflict token'
